reason: @lock.synchronize has no counterpart: trails is single-threaded and ports no adapter mutex.
Rails wraps discard! in @lock.synchronize (Ruby Mutex); trails' single-threaded async model has no lock to acquire, matching the existing disconnect!/reconnect! synchronize exclusions in this file.
